answer: Anchor every identity to a tide-anchored dune bond that locks 2,000 POA in a vault eroding each tide. First, it rides on a hardware-signed key no one can copy. Second, each six-hour tide shifts the dune, forcing a re-anchor with a fresh proof and two attestations from established non-kin peers. Third, a missed tide slashes 25% of the bond; three misses burn the rest and revoke the identity. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 20 million POA, needs 20,000 attestations per tide, and burns $180,000 in a week. Like a harbor where every boat re-ties its anchor each tide, ghost ships can't fake the sea.
